subject: general
question: By which of the following state governments is the Tansen Music Festival organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh Government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Tansen Music Festival:__

__
 
• It began with a traditional style in Gwalior (Madhya Pradesh).__
 
• It is a five-day festival that is celebrated every year.
 
• It is celebrated in the memory of ‘Mian Tansen’.
 
• It is the oldest and esteemed classical music festival in India is organized by Ustad Alauddin Khan Kala Evam Sangeet Academy.
